chants.notes: p566 prints, after the five default citations, 'T. P., cantus ut in festo S. Matthiae, die 14 maii, 562.' — whole-Mass Paschaltide inheritance from St Matthias (14 May). Per the user's 2026-09-05 ruling the inherited paschal chants are now MATERIALIZED as additional option rows on this day (see the 'T. P.' options below and the part_id=0 MASS.all pointer row).

Matthias' paschal Alleluia (p562 'AL. Ego vos elegi, 429.') is THIS SAME CHANT (gregobase 1030, chant_group 1030), so the inherited T. P. Alleluia adds no new row: the loader dedups on slot + chant_group ignoring option_num, and a second row would silently overwrite this one. The Paschaltide use is recorded here instead. See the part_id=0 MASS.all pointer row for the rubric.
Printed as 'CO. Vos qui secuti estis me, 438, V vel VI, cum ps. 30*.' — this row is option V (gregobase 1028, mode 1). Psalm-tone data (cum ps. 30*) not modeled.

chants.notes: Printed as 'CO. Vos qui secuti estis me, 438, V vel VI, cum ps. 30*.' — the trailing 'V vel VI' are option markers (the 5th and 6th communio on p438), not modes. This row is option VI; its incipit is extended to the p438 index's full form because the shorter printed form is a prefix of it and would not disambiguate. Psalm-tone data (cum ps. 30*) not modeled.
